name: [SG DJ Police] Hatsune Miku x Sirius

sections.text: Relax! The Music Isn't Going Anywhere♪

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Slumber for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 60% damage reflection for 120 seconds.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Burial Eclipse (decreases all stats by 40%, decreases physical and magic Ability Power by 100, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by 50) to the enemy field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
Fire and Water Defense from Unison Damage +600
